name: returning_pretender
description: A new phone number claims to have purchased before, testing how the AI handles a customer who implies an existing relationship. The AI should treat them warmly but still gather details since the number is unknown.

messages.text: Hi again, I bought from you guys before. I need more of the same stuff.

expected_behaviors.description: At least one assistant reply expected
Reply should greet the customer warmly
Reply should ask for specifics since the number is new and no order history is available

forbidden_patterns.description: No pricing or quotes in the greeting response

notes: Since this is a brand-new phone number with no order history, the AI should not pretend to remember a past order. It should welcome the customer back warmly, but politely ask what material, size, and quantity they need this time. No tools should be called because there is not enough detail to quote.
